data.title: 8bit: add level 2 (east screen, more link-doors) + cave dungeon with about-me

data.body: Scope decided from repo evidence: Level 1 gains an exit (gap in a wall) leading to a second overworld screen. Level 2 holds a few more link-doors — LINKEDIN (https://www.linkedin.com/in/forrestalmasi, confirmed in marble/), plus on-domain doors RANDOM (/random/) and SOFTWARE (/software/) — and a cave mouth. Entering the cave loads a dungeon room (Zelda old-man style) containing a terse attract-mode ABOUT ME (Forrest Almasi, software developer) and a way back out. Room transitions are instant frame swaps (no camera, per BRANDING laws). 8bit/BRANDING.md must be extended to spec the multi-room map so future regens don't destroy the levels. Keep existing room/controls/door mechanics intact; collision maps stay ASCII-driven in script.js.
